adaptation: training/development only; no test feedback until complete final programme locked
empirical_holdout_forecasting: explicitly unselected additional endpoint, not substituted for memory comparison
protected_seed_custody: fresh live operator producer commits separate development/test networks before exposure; candidate never receives test labels or source seeds
reference_competence: unqualified; required for every test stratum
reference_formula: Both use source per-row eps=0.001 normalization and ridge in the projected-neuron metric; one fixes lambda=10, one chooses from the fixed grid on development networks only.
statistic: paired network-level normalized trapezoidal AUC; one-sided Bonferroni percentile bounds across fixed references within a stratum

target_representation.retrieval: Exact Gram-metric Euclidean distances in the centered original projected-neuron basis, not latent Euclidean distance. Algebraic equivalence remains unqualified.

time_independent_queries: For each network and upper-delay endpoint, the operator independently samples a delay for each query from that endpoint and every preceding grid delay, using a protected precommitted stream. Same mixing applies to development. No progressive in-place source shuffle is silently relabeled equivalent.
